mappings.rationale: A deterministic portable-text gate is a specified toolchain control.
mappings.limitation: Text normalization alone does not secure a development toolchain.

mappings.rationale: Path and symlink confinement reduces unintended modification outside the reviewed repository boundary.
mappings.limitation: It does not establish repository authorization or access controls.

mappings.rationale: Rejecting unresolved merge markers is one bounded automated source review.
mappings.limitation: It does not identify security vulnerabilities generally.

mappings.rationale: Explicit format ownership makes required development checks reviewable.
mappings.limitation: Classification does not define all security requirements.

mappings.rationale: Immutable action references make workflow inputs more consistent and reviewable.
mappings.limitation: Pinning actions does not establish a SLSA build level or trusted builder.

mappings.rationale: Explicit least-privilege workflow permissions directly support minimum CI/CD privileges.
mappings.limitation: Static workflow inspection cannot verify repository-level defaults or runtime grants.

mappings.rationale: Checking local workflow references is a bounded review for broken or misleading execution paths.
mappings.limitation: It does not review dynamically constructed paths or workflow behavior.

mappings.rationale: Compilation checks source against the selected Python interpreter grammar.
mappings.limitation: Successful compilation does not prove runtime correctness or cross-implementation semantics.

mappings.rationale: The entry-point policy makes the intended command interpreter explicit.
mappings.limitation: POSIX leaves hash-bang handling unspecified, so this is a portability convention only.

mappings.rationale: The checker resolves repository-local destinations expressed through Markdown link syntax.
mappings.limitation: It does not establish complete CommonMark parsing or external URL availability.

mappings.rationale: The JSON parser rejects texts outside the accepted JSON grammar.
mappings.limitation: Parser acceptance does not prove schema conformance or semantic correctness.

mappings.rationale: Credential and private-path scanning helps prevent unintended sensitive data storage.
mappings.limitation: Pattern matching cannot prove that all sensitive information is absent.

mappings.rationale: A digest-bound policy lock records immutable quality inputs for later provenance.
mappings.limitation: The lock is not build provenance and does not establish any SLSA level.

mappings.rationale: Both contracts require consumers to identify the exact machine-readable specification version.
mappings.limitation: An AWQ lock is not an SPDX document or software bill of materials.

mappings.rationale: Explicit bounds and non-claims keep formal review evidence auditable.
mappings.limitation: Documentation checks do not execute a model or prove implementation refinement.

mappings.rationale: Cargo.lock records the resolved Rust dependency set in applicable workspaces.
mappings.limitation: A lockfile does not audit vulnerabilities, licenses, or malicious packages.

mappings.rationale: Gradle verification metadata complements the declared JVM dependency list with reviewed digests.
mappings.limitation: Verification metadata does not prove dependency behavior is safe or the list is complete.

mappings.rationale: A deterministic vocabulary check is one bounded automated source review.
mappings.limitation: Lexical matching cannot establish semantic correctness or terminology completeness.
